metadata.case_name: CHEUNG SIK KWAN v. LAM SAU MUI

plaintiff.occupation_before: property officer in the management office of the incorporated owners of Connie Tower

injuries.description: back and buttock injury resulting in back pain and left lower limb pain and weakness
injuries.body_part: back and buttock; left lower limb
source: The Medical Assessment Board Certificate of Review of Assessment under section 16G of the Employees' Compensation Ordinance, Cap. 282, certified Mr Cheung's injuries to be back and buttock injury resulting in back pain and left lower limb pain and weakness.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of nerve root of lumbar spine

source: Dr Ho confirmed Mr Cheung's pain and weakness of his left lower limb and, according to Dr Ho, Mr Cheung's complaints of haemospermia and erectile dysfunction was examined by Dr Ho. It is Dr Ho's belief that the haemospermia could be trauma-induced, causing the granulation tissue in the genital urinary tract to bleed more easily than normal tissue when congested during sex.
injuries.icd_description: Injury to male genital organ without specification of injury type

source: Dr Ho attributed haemospermia as a definite cause for Mr Cheung's erectile dysfunction.

In any event, in Dr Ng's opinion, haemospermia has no harmful effect, nor causes any permanent disability. Neither is there any effective specific treatment. Dr Ng agreed with Dr Ho that haemospermia is the contributing factor of Mr Cheung's erectile dysfunction.

manifestations.description: tenderness of the scrotum and testes
mild tenderness over the sacro-iliac region of his back
left lower limb pain and weakness
50 per cent decrease of sensation on the whole left thigh
decrease in power of left lower limb due to pain
need to use a walking stick (earlier)

treatments_received: consultation at United Christian Hospital Accident and Emergency Department
medical examinations by orthopaedic surgeon and urologists
treatments_future: urologist supervision four times a year
annual check-up with ECG, urinalysis and blood test

losses.description: Intermittent pain at left buttock, pain down the back and inner side of left thigh to back of left knee, decreased sensation on left thigh, left lower limb pain and weakness and earlier reliance on a walking stick.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Sexual inconvenience, haemospermia and erectile dysfunction and the necessity of using Viagra.
